政策与欧盟零污染行动计划关系

Disclosure of contextual information on relations between policies implemented and how policies contribute to EU Action Plan Towards Zero Pollution for Air, Water and Soil。政策与欧盟零污染行动计划关系。污染介质、关注物质、高度关注物质及事故情境分开；政策内容不等于实际减排成果。
